verdict.rationale: Jules's own docs say it provides a diff of its changes that you can browse and approve, and that it then creates a PR. The API docs add that by default no PR is created automatically, so a review-and-approve gate before the PR is a first-party capability. The plan-approval step is a separate pre-coding gate and is not counted here. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the diff-review UI and approval flow, explicit confirmation that diff approval is what triggers PR creation, and independent hands-on corroboration of reviewing diffs before a PR.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request

citations.quote: Jules provides a diff of the changes. Quickly browse and approve code edits.
Jules creates a PR of the changes.
By default, no PR will be automatically created.
